primary_claim: seq2feature, a 5.3MB text-only probe distilled from a Gemma-2-9B SAE, recovers the SAE's concept readout from output text alone with 0.956 top-5 concept agreement and 0.90 per-concept AUC, beating bag-of-words (0.84/0.75) and zero-shot embedding (0.23/0.53) baselines, while running on CPU and degrading legibly out of distribution.

effect.metric: top-5 concept agreement with SAE ground truth / per-concept AUC
effect.value: 0.956 top-5 agreement, 0.90 AUC (seq2feature int8, 5.3MB) vs 0.84/0.75 bag-of-words, 0.23/0.53 embedding baseline, 1.00/1.00 SAE teacher

contradicts_or_qualifies: notes Bricken et al. (2025) explore a similar auditing-model paradigm where an auditor model requests output from a reviewed model, but describes this work's UI-sharing pattern as a much more lightweight and generalized version
stated_future_work: optimize the probe's inference latency, which was not a target of optimization (currently ~150ms per interaction)
curate safety-relevant labels from the teacher's label set rather than generic concepts for a safety-focused probe
further investigate and map the emergent 'flashpoint' decision-boundary detection capability in future probe versions
run a more exhaustive hyperparameter/compression search (codebooks, mixed precision) that was not completed here
limitations_stated: probe coverage is only as good as the corpus and 2048-label set it was trained on; concepts outside this label set cannot be detected even if the SAE detects them
probe fails on out-of-domain concepts not represented in training data, e.g. misreading non-English text as code or chess notation as algebra
per-concept AUC drops from 0.90 in-distribution to 0.75 out of distribution (medical/legal domains)
probe is only a 0.54 cosine match to the SAE teacher's activation magnitudes, so predictions are directionally correct but not magnitude-precise
the SAE and its labels are themselves an LLM-generated proxy interpretation of the model's activations, not verified ground truth
quote: My seq2feature 5.3MB text-only probe reproduces 90% of the capability of an SAE on held out text.
